High-speed track: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), railways tagged as high-speed, with each stretch's opening year from its start_date tag, the year of the rest of the same line, or the line's opening date on Wikidata. Stretches with no known year are left out. Parallel tracks are counted once, so lengths are approximate. Conventional railway lines: 28 main historic lines (not the whole network), traced from their OpenStreetMap route relations, with opening years from Wikidata or published histories; lines built in stages appear section by section. · Highcharts.com
